decision: NX-028 D3–D5 (owner 2026-10-10, "all as recommended"): a staff member takes over one conversation (or one whole consumer); default 2 hours, at most 24 hours. While taken over the Agent does not compete: no message Run, no fallback reply Run, Agent outbound refused at dispatch (NXC06). Expiry ends it automatically and escalates to the owner. On hand-back or expiry only the latest still unanswered inbound message returns to normal pending-reply handling; earlier ones are recorded as settled by the takeover and never replayed; plan reevaluation takes it from there. Initial values; owner-adjustable by a new version.
